clues: Think of a town in Spain. It lies in the Castile-La Mancha region of that land.
This town once held the cold mark for all Spain. A weather post there logged minus 28 degrees.
Long ago, it once led a small Moorish state of its own. Christian forces took it back in 1129.
In 1154, a lord gave it a wide charter. He made it a near free fief of his own.
Its lords made a proud claim. They said they ruled by the grace of God alone.
